name: Jihoz
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Axie Infinity co-founder Jihoz tweeted that his personal two addresses have been compromised. The attack is limited to his personal accounts and is unrelated to the validation or operation of the Ronin chain. Additionally, the leaked keys are unrelated to the operations of Sky Mavis. He reassured everyone that strict security measures have been taken for all related activities.
